Hello Safety Team,


I am a clinical care coordinator at Demo Family Practice (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 86-year-old female patient with a history of hypertension received their fourth dose of their usual medication (dose: 10mg) via oral.
Treatment started on 2026-05-06.
Approximately 10 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed occasional dizziness.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
J. Okafor (fictional reporter)
Demo Family Practice
